actual_training.detail: Neural model parameters updated by real gradients; measured before/after loss

anneal_reserve.detail: Reserve content absent from main stages; only reserve shards admitted in cooldown

automated_tests.detail: Important invariant tests executed in the same interpreter

contamination_firewall.detail: Embedded test canary blocked by token-independent text fingerprints

crash_resume_no_skips_duplicates.detail: Worker killed by os._exit inside transaction; exact next batch, source-span hash and checkpoint matched after rollback

evaluation_validation_firewall.detail: Heldout/proxy admission attempts blocked; no heldout shard in training

explicit_fork.detail: New branch restores earlier checkpoint and explicitly changes RNG/data stream

historical_replay.detail: Historical packs read from ledger, not resampled; model, optimizer, loader and RNG also reproduced

immutable_shards.detail: All admitted training shard content hashes revalidated against token records

learning_trace.detail: Actual natural-log cross-entropy linked to target token/source/phase/checkpoint; perplexity recomputed

loss_attention_position_masks.detail: Block-diagonal causal masks applied by model; role masks and reset position IDs verified

mixture_curriculum_floors.detail: Exact integer optimizer-step quotas and protected token-position floors; rounded shares reported

detail.method: exact first-order momentum-SGD proxy projection; small-model OPUS-style baseline

packing_correctness.detail: Rebuilt all source token spans; packed content and attention hashes validated

throughput_accounting.detail: Measured CPU timing and reconstructible useful-token counts; no claimed GPU throughput

tokenizer_integrity.detail: Frozen tokenizer hashes agree across manifests and checkpoint

scope: tiny real CPU training; logical rank partitioning; no distributed GPU claim
